{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling the thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_customers = sales_df[sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Confirm the number of loyal customers and conversions
n_loyal = len(loyal_customers)
n_converted = loyal_customers['converted'].sum()

# Calculate the fraction
fraction_converted = n_converted / n_loyal

# Print detailed breakdown
print(f"Number of loyal customers: {n_loyal}")
print(f"Number of converted loyal customers: {n_converted}")
print(f"Fraction converted: {fraction_converted}")"}
